data.scope: Two15-frame real RGB-D subsets, each2400Gaussians at96x72; known mocap camera;150steps; no original paper table matched

data.performance: 20 sequential isolated profile cases completed before training; training wall-clock is not the isolated benchmark

data.mps_verified_by: 10successful isolated initializer profiles and24completed formal MPS runs
data.performance_protocol: one isolated process per case, before concurrent training

data.calibration: ROS default525/525/319.5/239.5; no undistortion, as recommended by TUM for pre-registered RGB-D
data.pose: interpolated mocap camera-to-world; linear position + quaternion SLERP
data.controlled_renderer: independent bilinear point reprojection with nearest-surface z-buffer
data.controlled_limit: Existing native image blur is retained; this is additional controlled blur on real RGB-D, not sensor clean GT.
data.initialization: Training depth only for geometry; colors from respective training observation track, never held-out frames
data.publication: Original/processed RGB-D arrays are local ignored caches, not committed or uploaded.
data.initial_sigma: max(0.8 pixel projected world scale, min(0.8 nearest selected-point spacing, 0.05m))
